categories.main_business_segments: Seres Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the new energy vehicle (NEV) sector, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, sales, and services of NEVs and core components such as electric drive systems. The company also engages in traditional fuel vehicles and other automotive-related products, but its core emphasis is on high-end, intelligent electric vehicles, including SUVs and family vehicles under the 'Wenjie' brand.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including software-defined vehicles, intelligent extended-range electric powertrains with a thermal efficiency of 44.8%, AI-powered intelligent driving systems (ADS 3.0 upgraded to ADS 4.0), and smart manufacturing platforms integrating AI, big data, IoT, and digital twins. It has developed the 'Magic Cube' technology platform for cross-domain integration and continuous software and hardware upgrades, and maintains a comprehensive intelligent safety system covering multiple dimensions of vehicle safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Seres serves primarily individual consumers and families seeking high-end, intelligent new energy vehicles in China, with expanding presence in overseas markets including Europe and the US. Its key markets include the domestic Chinese market, where it ranks among the top in the high-end NEV segment, and selected international markets through subsidiaries and brand promotion activities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and multiple manufacturing bases in Chongqing and other Chinese cities. It also has subsidiaries and operations in the United States (Silicon Valley), Indonesia, Brazil, the Netherlands, and Singapore, reflecting a growing international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Seres operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive supply chain, focusing on vehicle assembly, core component manufacturing (such as electric drives and batteries), and direct sales and after-sales services. It collaborates closely with upstream suppliers like CATL and Bosch to ensure integrated supply chain efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on high-end brand positioning, software-defined vehicle technology, AI integration, and intelligent manufacturing. R&D priorities include intelligent extended-range electric powertrains, advanced driver assistance systems, AI-powered smart cockpits, and digitalized quality and logistics management. The company emphasizes continuous innovation, ecosystem collaboration, and talent development to sustain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of new energy vehicles and automotive components, supplemented by after-sales services, digital services, and licensing of intellectual property. The company also engages in direct sales and dealership models domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Seres is positioned as a leading Chinese high-end NEV manufacturer, ranking among the top in the domestic luxury electric SUV market. It competes with traditional luxury brands and emerging Chinese NEV makers, leveraging technology innovation and brand elevation to capture market share. It is noted as the fourth globally profitable NEV company.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Seres achieved revenue of approximately RMB 145.18 billion, a 305% increase year-over-year, driven by a 183% increase in NEV sales to 426,885 units. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 5.95 billion, marking a turnaround to profitability. The company’s total assets grew 84% to RMB 94.36 billion, reflecting rapid expansion and strong cash flow generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Seres emphasizes a unique value proposition centered on intelligent, software-defined vehicles with superior safety, performance, and user experience. Its products feature advanced AI-driven smart cockpits, high-efficiency extended-range powertrains, and comprehensive lifecycle user services branded as 'Intelligent Enjoyment Worry-Free'. The company differentiates itself through continuous technology upgrades, high-quality manufacturing, and a premium brand image targeting the new luxury automotive segment.
